findings.evidence: grep -rn "closure_induction₂" TauCeti/ → TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/CharacterTable/VirtualCharacter.lean:129, TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/RingOfDefinition.lean:89, TauCeti/RingTheory/Binomial.lean:107. Mathlib has no such lemma: Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Subgroup.lean defines only pointwise `AddSubgroup.mul`, and `AddSubmonoid.closure_mul_closure` (Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Submonoid/Pointwise.lean:151) is at submonoid level, so the helper belongs in TauCeti — but in a reusable location.
findings.fix: Move `AddSubgroup.mul_mem_closure` (and `Subring.toAddSubgroup_closure`) into a general module importable by all three sites (e.g. a `TauCeti/Algebra/Ring/Subgroup.lean`), then rewrite the two existing proofs as `AddSubgroup.mul_mem_closure ?_ hx hy` with only their `mem` case surviving, deleting the five boilerplate cases at each site.
findings.issue: `AddSubgroup.mul_mem_closure` is the set-generic form of scaffolding that already exists verbatim twice in TauCeti, but it is declared inside a binomial-coefficient file, so neither clone can use it and the repo ends with three copies. `TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/RingOfDefinition.lean:89-102` (`mul_mem_addSubgroupClosure_mul_range_pow`) is character-for-character identical in its five non-`mem` cases, and `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/CharacterTable/VirtualCharacter.lean:129-141` (`mul_mem_virtualCharacters`) is the same proof with `rw` in place of `simpa`.

findings.evidence: grep -rn "ringChooseSpan_induction" TauCeti/ → only its declaration at TauCeti/RingTheory/Binomial.lean:165; body at lines 168-176 is `rw [ringChooseSpan_def]; induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction` with each case discharged by the corresponding hypothesis.
findings.fix: Delete `ringChooseSpan_induction`; consumers use `rw [ringChooseSpan_def]` (already public) and `AddSubgroup.closure_induction`. Unlike `ringChooseSpan_def`/`ringChooseSpan_le_iff`, this lemma was not part of the api-design-mandated barrier, so removing it conflicts with nothing.
findings.issue: `ringChooseSpan_induction` restates Mathlib's `AddSubgroup.closure_induction` for `ringChooseSpan` and has no consumer anywhere in the repo; its own proof is just `rw [ringChooseSpan_def]` followed by that Mathlib lemma, so any caller can do the same in one line. This is a parallel induction API for the same subgroup with no earning use.

summary: The product formula and the span-is-a-subring identification are genuinely new; Mathlib has no Ring.choose product lemma and no such closure statement. Two duplication defects remain: the new generic closure helper is buried where the two existing clones of it cannot use it, and ringChooseSpan_induction is an unused restatement of AddSubgroup.closure_induction.
